27.text: Deep sorrow on account of the loss of some near friend must also be

28.text: mentioned as a reason for voluntary death. I have spoken before of a hus-

29.text: band who wanted to follow his dead wife.³

30.text: Last among the motives of voluntary death, tædium vitæ should be

31.text: mentioned. I have related the case of a man named Kaˊtɪk, who, when

32.text: speaking with me, declared that he did not desire to live any longer. He

33.text: gave as his reason that fortune did not like him, though his herd and family

34.text: were prospering. I did not pay much attention to his words, but a few

35.text: months afterwards I heard that he had really had himself strangled.⁴

36.text: Another case of the same character refers to a widow of forty, who lived

37.text: with her son and two nephews, being an owner of a considerable herd. She

38.text: felt that life held no pleasures for her. She was in fear that her herd might

39.text: decrease, and that she would feel ashamed to live. She died by strangulation.

40.text: The case was related to me by Aiñanwaˊt.
